title: Rewire pp16/ts14 regression assertions onto the real widget — pp16 tests Flutter's SliverGrid math instead of ProfileGrid's config, ts14's second test reads a bare ARB getter instead of the rendered archive dialog
why: pp16's two tests only import package:flutter/rendering.dart and flutter_test — they never import ProfileGrid (profile_grid.dart), instead constructing SliverGridDelegateWithMaxCrossAxisExtent/WithFixedCrossAxisCount from scratch and asserting on Flutter's own layout math. Currently ProfileGrid does use maxCrossAxisExtent:260 (profile_grid.dart:39-40), so the test's numbers happen to agree today, but nothing in the test file would notice if that gridDelegate: argument were changed, removed, or reverted to FixedCrossAxisCount(2) — the exact PP-16 bug the file claims to guard. Similarly, ts14's second test reads AppLocalizations.of(context)!.parentDeleteTrackArchiveBody directly and asserts on its string content instead of opening the real archive dialog (as the sibling ts3 test's intent describes) and reading the rendered Text — it cannot catch _showDeleteDialog being edited to reference the sibling own-profile key deleteTrackArchiveBody instead.
recommendation: pp16: pump the real ProfileGrid widget at the wide-tablet viewport and read its actual gridDelegate/tile RenderBox size instead of re-instantiating a delegate. ts14: extend a widget test that opens the real _showDeleteDialog via longPress and asserts the rendered dialog body Text equals l10n.parentDeleteTrackArchiveBody.
acceptance_criteria: Reverting profile_grid.dart:39 to SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(crossAxisCount: 2, ...) fails pp16's test suite.
Swapping parent_track_management_screen.dart's dialog content to l10n.deleteTrackArchiveBody (the own-profile key) fails ts14's suite.
